laws.rule: Kochi Youth Protection and Development Ordinance (高知県青少年保護育成条例), art. 19. The ordinance sets the late-night period as 10 pm to 4 am. A guardian may not let a young person (generally under 18) go out in that period except for special reasons. Anyone else is barred from taking such a young person out, going about with them or keeping them out in that period without the guardian's consent or another proper reason. The offence for others carries a fine of up to JPY 200,000 (about A$1,805). Rates: RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82.
